module.title: Loyalty, Discounts, Coupons and Referrals
module.business_purpose: The rewards and discount engine end users asked for: loyalty programs with tiers and a points ledger, promotions with flexible discount rules, single/multi-use coupons and promo codes with redemption tracking, app-usage rewards (earn points/credits for booking, completing courses, referrals, streaks), and a referral program. Discounts apply at checkout (module 42 payments / 17 billing) and credits settle into wallets (module 42B). Fully auditable; abuse-resistant by construction.
